GSAP 3.13.0 is loaded locally from gsap.min.js when present.
Run: python3 tools/install_opening_gsap.py
The official library could not be downloaded in the build environment.
No imitation GSAP library is included. The native fallback is labelled in the UI.
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
The installer preserves the library's copyright and license header.
